name: Employment and Skills Service (employment support)
whoFor: Kirklees residents out of work, or in work and wanting to progress.
eligibility: Out of work, or in work and wanting to progress

selfReferral.note: Refer yourself by phone, email or the online enquiry form

activities.name: Employment support
activities.summary: Advisers help you get past what's stopping you working, then find and apply for jobs: CVs, interview practice and a plan. Also helps people in work who want to move up or change jobs.

provenance.source: Kirklees additional services spreadsheet v3 (October 2026), row 14
provenance.evidence: Page changed Aug 2025; council Armed Forces page (Oct 2026) still refers to it. Also runs the care-leaver strand of Connect to Work.
